sahneler.metin: A chartered DC-8 carrying US soldiers crashed just after take-off in Newfoundland.
All two hundred fifty six people aboard were killed.
It had stopped at Gander to refuel in winter.
The majority of investigators blamed ice on the wings.
Ice reduces lift and makes a heavy jet climb poorly.
Several board members disagreed and argued for other causes.
The split findings remain a case study in investigation.

aciklama:
Arrow Air 1285 crashed shortly after take-off from Gander. The cause: probable wing ice contamination reducing lift, though the cause was disputed by investigators.
